title: Augmentation normalization of a chosen general-site Cech edge
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small category, $U\in\mathcal C$, and $S$ chosen tuple products for a family $U_i\to U$, with Cech complex $\check C_S$ [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex]. Let $\mathcal E$ be an abelian category with enough injectives and $P:\mathcal E\to\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal C^{op},\mathbf{Ab})$ additive [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. For $A\in\mathcal E$ and an injective resolution $A\to I$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions], define $D^{t,r}=\check C_S^t(P(I^r))$ by applying the existing Cech functor termwise and exchanging indices. Its total $T_I$ uses $d_C+(-1)^t d_I$ [def-sp-double-complex-total]. Augmentation data consist of cochain maps $\alpha_I:\Gamma(U,P(I))\to T_I$ and $\beta_I:\check C_S(P(A))\to T_I$ whose degree-$n$ components are respectively restriction to every length-one tuple followed by inclusion at $(0,n)$, and the image of $A\to I^0$ on every length-$(n+1)$ tuple followed by inclusion at $(n,0)$. Put $\Gamma_P(U,-)=P(-)(U)$. An edge $e:\check H_S^q(P(A))\to R^q\Gamma_P(U,-)(A)$ is normalized if for every $I$ there exist these specified augmentation maps, $\alpha_I$ is a quasi-isomorphism, and $e$ followed by the injective-resolution identification and $H^q(\alpha_I)$ is $H^q(\beta_I)$. This condition specifies the normalization, not its existence or the acyclic-edge theorem.
